code:
use default

let sieve_limit = 1_300_000
let composite = LIST(sieve_limit)

(0::sieve_limit) |> each(_ => composite.add(false))

for candidate in 2::sieve_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= sieve_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= sieve_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

let primes =
    (2::sieve_limit)
        |> filter(candidate => !composite[candidate])
        |> map(prime => cast bigint(prime))
        |> collect()

product(values: List[bigint]) -> bigint =>
    case values.count
    when 0 then 1n
    when 1 then values[0]
    else
        let middle = values.count / 2 in
        product(values[0..middle]) * product(values[middle..<0])
    esac

primorial(index: int) -> bigint => product(primes[0..index])

write_line("the first ten primorial numbers:")

(0..10)
    |> each(index =>
        write_line("  primorial({index}) = {primorial(index)}"))

write_line()
write_line("digits in larger primorial numbers:")

[10, 100, 1_000, 10_000, 100_000]
    |> each(index =>
        write_line("  primorial({index,7:N0}) has "
                   "{primorial(index).to_string().length,7:N0} digits"))
